title: The target-chain bar augmentation is a homotopy isomorphism
statement: The canonical augmentation from the target-chain bar [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-target-retraction] to the supplied telescope cone is invertible in the homotopy category.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: The finite cone-block diagram is definitionally the objectwise cone of identity minus successor from partial sums through n to partial sums through n+1. Its two cocones to the full coproduct are compatible with the telescope differential by differential_inclusionAll. Both partial-sum augmentations are homotopy isomorphisms by the explicit extra degeneracy. Apply coneAugmentation_isIso; its cone cocone is exactly the targetCocone. No upper bound or flatness of the sequence is used.
